# Evercraft Web Agent / Fetch & Browser

Problem: An AI assistant or agent needs public web fetch/extraction, live-web discovery, browser automation, or user-authorized authenticated browsing without depending on a third-party browser-agent provider.
Pricing: No public machine price is advertised until runtime metering and production verification are complete.
Commercial state: discovery_only
Machine state: specialist_discovery_ready_runtime_gated
Public capability: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceGateway?action=web
Human review: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceGateway?view=service&public_id=evercraft-web-browser-agent-v1
Machine offer JSON: Not exposed until commercial verification is complete
Universal MCP: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp

Use when the user says or means:
- fetch a webpage for my AI agent
- read a URL for my AI agent
- web fetch API
- live web API for an AI agent
